package domain

import "time"

// TeacherDialogTurnCursor is the durable per-dialog fence used by dense v2
// teacher turns. It is deliberately separate from Dialog's message sequence.
type TeacherDialogTurnCursor struct {
	DialogID                 string
	NextTeacherTurnSequence  int64
	LastSourceEventID        string
	LastTeacherJobID         string
	LastTerminalOutcome      TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome
	LastTeacherResponseID    string
	LastNoEffectProofID      string
	LastRecoverableOutcomeID string
	LastFailureCode          string
	Revision                 int64
	UpdatedAt                time.Time
}

// TeacherDialogNoEffectProof is a durable reference to the Student-side
// absence/receipt reconciliation. StudentCommandID is optional evidence of an
// attempted command; it does not by itself assert that Student state changed.
type TeacherDialogNoEffectProof struct {
	ID               string
	SourceEventID    string
	TeacherJobID     string
	StudentCommandID string
	RecordedAt       time.Time
}

// TeacherDialogRecoverableOutcome is a durable recovery handle. The
// repository stores this record before linking it from the job and cursor.
type TeacherDialogRecoverableOutcome struct {
	ID                string
	SourceEventID     string
	TeacherJobID      string
	TurnCorrelationID string
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}
